apps.compose:
name: jellyfin
services:
  jellyfin:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/jellyfin:10.11.11
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: "${PUID:-1000}"
      PGID: "${PGID:-1000}"
      TZ: "${TZ:-UTC}"
    ports:
      - target: 8096
        published: "8096"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /DATA/AppData/jellyfin/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: /DATA/Media
        target: /media
        read_only: true
    x-casaos:
      envs:
        - container: PUID
          description:
            en_us: User identifier used for media files.
            es_es: Identificador de usuario utilizado para los archivos.
        - container: PGID
          description:
            en_us: Group identifier used for media files.
            es_es: Identificador de grupo utilizado para los archivos.
        - container: TZ
          description:
            en_us: Container timezone.
            es_es: Zona horaria del contenedor.
      ports:
        - container: "8096"
          description:
            en_us: Jellyfin web interface.
            es_es: Interfaz web de Jellyfin.
      volumes:
        - container: /config
          description:
            en_us: Persistent Jellyfin configuration.
            es_es: Configuración persistente de Jellyfin.
        - container: /media
          description:
            en_us: Read-only media library.
            es_es: Biblioteca multimedia de solo lectura.
x-casaos:
  id: jellyfin
  version: "10.11.11"
  architectures:
    - amd64
    - arm64
  main: jellyfin
  author: AlcoIT Software
  category: Media
  description:
    en_us: Private media system.
    es_es: Sistema privado de contenido multimedia.
  developer: Jellyfin
  icon: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/IceWhaleTech/CasaOS-AppStore@main/Apps/Jellyfin/icon.png
  index: /
  port_map: "8096"
  scheme: http
  store_app_id: com.alcoit.jellyfin
  tagline:
    en_us: Your media, under your control.
    es_es: Tu contenido multimedia bajo tu control.
  title:
    en_us: Jellyfin
    es_es: Jellyfin
apps.name: Jellyfin

apps.compose:
name: pi-hole
services:
  pi-hole:
    image: pihole/pihole:2026.05.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    ports:
      - target: 53
        published: "53"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 53
        published: "53"
        protocol: udp
      - target: 80
        published: "8081"
        protocol: tcp
    environment:
      TZ: "${TZ:-UTC}"
      FTLCONF_webserver_api_password: casaos
      FTLCONF_dns_listeningMode: all
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /DATA/AppData/pi-hole/etc-pihole
        target: /etc/pihole
    x-casaos:
      envs:
        - container: TZ
          description:
            en_us: Zona horaria del contenedor.
            es_es: Zona horaria del contenedor.
        - container: FTLCONF_webserver_api_password
          description:
            en_us: Pi-hole administrator password. Change the initial value.
            es_es: Contraseña de administración de Pi-hole. Cambia el valor inicial.
        - container: FTLCONF_dns_listeningMode
          description:
            en_us: Interfaces where Pi-hole accepts DNS queries.
            es_es: Interfaces donde Pi-hole acepta consultas DNS.
      ports:
        - container: "53"
          description:
            en_us: DNS port.
            es_es: Puerto DNS.
        - container: "53"
          protocol: udp
          description:
            en_us: DNS port.
            es_es: Puerto DNS.
        - container: "80"
          description:
            en_us: Pi-hole web interface.
            es_es: Interfaz web de Pi-hole.
      volumes:
        - container: /etc/pihole
          description:
            en_us: Persistent Pi-hole configuration.
            es_es: Configuración persistente de Pi-hole.
x-casaos:
  id: pi-hole
  version: "2026.05.0"
  architectures:
    - amd64
    - arm64
  main: pi-hole
  author: AlcoIT Software
  category: Network
  description:
    en_us: Network-wide DNS filtering.
    es_es: Filtrado DNS para toda la red.
  developer: Pi-hole
  icon: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/IceWhaleTech/CasaOS-AppStore@main/Apps/Pi-hole/icon.png
  index: /admin
  port_map: "8081"
  scheme: http
  store_app_id: com.alcoit.pihole
  tagline:
    en_us: Network-wide ad blocking.
    es_es: Bloqueo de publicidad para toda la red.
  title:
    en_us: Pi-hole
    es_es: Pi-hole
apps.name: Pi-hole
